question: What merit is attributed to recitation with lotus-seed and gold beads?
premises: Lotus-seed beads yield ten hundred thousandfold fruit.
Gold beads yield ten millionfold fruit.
inference: Lotus-seed beads give ten hundred thousandfold merit and gold beads ten millionfold.
plain_english: With lotus seeds it is ten hundred thousandfold, but with gold beads it is said to be ten millionfold.
